slides.title: Automated Classroom Attendance from a Single Handheld Sweep Video
slides.subtitle: An Edge-Native, CPU-Oriented Benchmark of Face Detectors under Real Classroom Conditions
key_takeaways: 10-second handheld video sweep captures an entire 60-student lecture hall.
Delivers verified roll-call in 1.54 seconds on an unaccelerated smartphone CPU.
100% offline edge processing with zero cloud server cost and zero biometric privacy exposure.

slides.title: The Attendance Bottleneck in Higher Education
slides.subtitle: Operational Overhead, Proxy Inflation, and Practical Failure Modes
key_takeaways: 3 to 7 minutes lost per lecture period (10% to 14% of total semester teaching time).
8% to 12% proxy inflation across manual sign-in sheets and smartcard tapping.
Fixed CCTV arrays are cost-prohibitive (₹1.5L+ per hall), while static podium photos fail due to line-of-sight occlusion.

slides.title: The 9-Stage Edge-Native C++ Pipeline
slides.subtitle: Deterministic Zero-Garbage-Collection Execution via Dart FFI
stages: 4. YuNet INT8 Face Detection + Horizon SAHI

slides.title: Dual-Resolution Processing & Adaptive Blur Recovery
slides.subtitle: Overcoming Frame Starvation in Handheld Classroom Video Sweeps
key_takeaways: Panning motion drops Laplacian variance to 12-30; static tau=100 dropped 85% of frames.
Adaptive fallback: If < 35% of frames pass, dynamically retains top 65% sharpest frames.
Dual-resolution split: 640x360 for 38.5ms detection; 1080p native crops for ArcFace.

slides.title: Perspective Vanishing-Line Projective Geometry Model
slides.subtitle: Constraining Face Scale and Eliminating Spurious Detections
key_takeaways: Classroom vanishing horizon: y_horizon = f · tan(φ_camera).
Monotonic scale envelope: h(y) = k · (y - y_horizon)^γ rejects T-shirt and poster false positives.
Score stratification: tau_det=0.30 near horizon for rear rows, tau_det=0.55 for front rows.

slides.title: Depth-Stratified Horizon SAHI & Dynamic Contrast
slides.subtitle: Resolving Distant Rear-Row Students Without 9x Grid Compute Penalty
key_takeaways: Slices exclusively the narrow vanishing horizon band [0.15H, 0.55H] where rows 6-12 reside.
Cascaded dynamic trigger: Bypasses SAHI if initial pass detects expected student count.
2x2 CLAHE on luminance Y-channel provides +34% contrast boost under washed-out projector lighting.

slides.title: Spatial Desk-Tracklet Fusion (ST-DTF)
slides.subtitle: ORB/RANSAC Homography Motion Compensation & Seated Desk Stabilization
key_takeaways: Handheld panning causes high inter-frame velocity that breaks standard ByteTrack/DeepSORT.
Fast ORB + RANSAC calculates 3x3 homography H_t, projecting detections into a global desk grid.
Detections with spatial IoU ≥ 0.40 in desk coordinates are aggregated into unified Desk Tracklets.

slides.title: Multi-Criteria Quality Exemplar Pruning
slides.subtitle: Slashing ArcFace Neural Inferences by 75% for Mobile Thermal Stability
key_takeaways: 50 students × 40 sharp frames = 2,000 raw detections (35+ seconds CPU compute).
Quality function Q = 0.40·Conf + 0.40·Frontality + 0.20·Scale ranks every detection.
ArcFace runs strictly on top k=2 exemplars per desk, cutting forward passes to ≤ 100 in 0.7s.

slides.title: 6-DoF 3D Pose Estimation & Frontality Normalization
slides.subtitle: Direct Perspective-n-Point Head Pose Calculation via solvePnP
key_takeaways: Uses 5 YuNet 2D facial landmarks fitted against a canonical 3D face model via solvePnP.
Extracts 6-DoF [Yaw, Pitch, Roll] with zero auxiliary neural network overhead.
Frontality metric cos(ψ)cos(θ)cos(φ) and synthetic 3D frontalization align faces into 112x112 canonical view.

slides.title: Identity Consolidation: Average-Linkage HAC
slides.subtitle: Robust Identity Clustering Across Fragmented Tracklets
key_takeaways: Resolves tracklet splits caused by transient occlusions (e.g. teacher walking past).
Average-linkage Hierarchical Agglomerative Clustering in cosine distance space (tau_cluster=0.35).
Generates one noise-free 512-D centroid vector per physical student in under 2ms.

slides.title: Bayesian Asymmetric Matching & 'All-Present' Prior
slides.subtitle: Optimal Decision Boundaries Under Classroom Prior Distributions
key_takeaways: Closed-classroom prior: P(Present) ≈ 0.85-0.95; intruder prior P(Intruder) ≈ 0.01.
Asymmetric risk: False Negative cost (marking present absent) = 10.0; False Positive cost = 1.0.
Bayesian decision rule validates calibrated operating threshold tau_match = 0.38 via 11-point ROC analysis.

slides.title: Passive Sweep Parallax 3D Liveness / Anti-Spoofing
slides.subtitle: Zero-Cost 3D Geometric Anti-Spoofing Against Proxy Photo & Screen Attacks
key_takeaways: 2D Spoof (iPad screen / photo): Rigid planar surface adhering to single homography H_screen (Residual error ε ≈ 0).
3D Live Human Head: Differential motion parallax creates non-zero depth variance (Depth Var > tau_3D).
Rejects 88% of proxy attacks at only 15ms compute overhead with zero specialist sensors.

slides.title: Progressive Continuous Roster Adaptation
slides.subtitle: Quality-Weighted Exponential Moving Average (EMA) Gallery Updating
key_takeaways: Overcomes semester biometric drift (haircut, spectacles, beard growth).
Quality-gated EMA update: g^(t+1) = Norm((1 - α·Q)g^(t) + α·Q·e_new) triggers only if Match ≥ 0.85.
Apple Face ID 3D multi-pose enrollment captures Frontal, Left 15°, and Right 15° vectors.

slides.title: Zero-Trust Edge Privacy & DPDP Act 2023 Compliance
slides.subtitle: Strict Legal Architecture Protecting Student Biometric Sovereignty
key_takeaways: Full compliance with India's DPDP Act 2023 and GDPR Article 9 (Sensitive Biometric Data).
Raw sweep video exists solely in transient RAM and is permanently purged post-sweep.
Mathematical 512-D embeddings are stored in local AES-256 encrypted SQLite; zero data sent over network.
